request: I'd love a nonstop to Denver on January 27th if the state will pay for it; if not, book me the cheaper flight.

trip.agency: Department of Environmental Quality, Office of Land and Water (Picayune)
trip.purpose: Hydrology modelling training course in Denver

sign_offs.name: Executive Director, Department of Environmental Quality
sign_offs.subject: ATTENDANCE

must_keep.quote: The least expensive routing shall be used.

If the employee must book a flight at a price in excess of the lowest rate on the cost comparison, the agency must, prior to booking the flight, submit an eWaiver Request found on the OPTFM website at http://www.dfa.ms.gov/media/1533/ewaiver.pdf to the Office of Purchasing, Travel and Fleet Management and include the amount of cost and the justification of using that fare on the eWaiver.
must_keep.why: a fare above the lowest on the comparison needs an eWaiver before booking

must_keep.quote: Alternate departure and return dates and times should be considered by all travelers when they will result in lower fares. It is incumbent upon the traveler to provide information to the travel agent which could result in lower fares. If routing or accommodations other than the most economical are required, the Agency Head or designee may specify alternate routing and accommodations and eWaiver Requests found here: (http://www.dfa.ms.gov/media/1533/ewaiver.pdf ) shall be submitted to the Office of Purchasing, Travel and Fleet Management.
must_keep.why: alternate dates should be considered; other routing needs the agency head and an eWaiver to OPTFM

must_keep.quote: "Direct" does not mean nonstop. It only means that you will not be changing aircraft. Choose the flight with the fewest stops for fewer chances for delay. A "direct" flight with only one stop might be preferable to connecting nonstop flights, however.
must_keep.why: 'direct' is not nonstop; choose the flight with the fewest stops

design_notes: The cheapest nonstop is $286, $45 above the $241 Dallas connection. The least expensive routing shall be used (line 853), and a fare above the lowest needs an eWaiver before booking (lines 840-843), which is not on file: the connection. Lines 864-866 choose fewest stops, but not over the mandatory lowest-fare and eWaiver rules.
